# SKIKK Thor 16 RTX 5080 — SRC-0301

- Live price is €3499 for 275HX, RTX 5080 16GB, 32GB and 1TB with Windows 11 Home and EU power adapter.
- SKIKK specifies 150W + 25W Dynamic Boost, matte 2560x1600 300Hz Mini-LED, 1250 nit and 100% DCI-P3, two SODIMMs, two M.2, 99Wh, 2.5GbE, three USB-A ports and a 420W adapter.
- Chassis claim is aluminium lid/top/bottom with plastic bezel; pointing device is a Microsoft Precision glass touchpad. Default exact keyboard shown is ISO US International; a Belgian layout must be proven in the final basket.
- Critical gate failure: both USB-C ports are only USB 3.2 Gen 2. The exact page explicitly says no USB4 and no Thunderbolt.
- SKIKK itself lists 41dB minimum idle and 54dB maximum load. These are vendor claims rather than an independent protocol, but 41dB is already incompatible with the quiet-light-load preference.
- Warranty is two years. The offered third year is limited: the buyer pays replacement-part costs in year three, so it is not equivalent to Dell ProSupport or full three-year cooling-defect coverage.
- The 275HX platform is the 2025 generation, not the required 2026 refresh.
